speaker: The Portal Mage
voice_direction: Intimate, weary confidence. A former guardian hiding guilt; grounded speech, not booming villain narration.

beats.text: That forest shouldn't be here.
The Spire took it. Just as it took a piece of your home.
At its summit, the Heart can send one stolen shard home.
Reach it. Before there is nothing left to send you home to.
If you fall, the portal pulls you back. Your relics keep the memory.
Those wards are failing. The guardians know it.
They think taking your shard will break what still holds.
They're right. Tear it out, and other worlds fall with it.
But reach the Heart, and you can open the prison without breaking it.

chapters.title: The Warden's confession
chapters.trigger: act3 threshold, not immediate boss identity reveal

beats.text: I was a Warden once.
I kept the doors closed. I told myself the worlds inside were safe.
Then I heard them disappear, one by one.
Stop whoever holds the Heart. Bring your people home.

chapters.title: A sky remembered
chapters.trigger: successful normal ending; do not promise every world is permanently freed

beats.text: A piece of your world is home again.
One shard is safe. There are others still inside.
That isn't the tower moving. Something outside is trying to get in.
Close the breach. Do not let it follow you home.

chapters.title: The tether holds
chapters.trigger: terminal failed run only, once on return

beats.text: I pulled you out when your tether broke.
You lost the path, not your chance. Rest. We can try again.

chapters.title: Another attempt
chapters.trigger: new run after failure; brief replacement for first-run exposition

beats.text: The Spire has shifted. The goal hasn't. This time, we go further.

chapters.title: Another world waits
chapters.trigger: new run after completed run; brief replacement for first-run exposition

beats.text: One shard returned. Another is still waiting. You know the way in.

loop_rules.success: One run returns one captive shard, not every world. Other fragments remain.
loop_rules.failure: The portal tether collapses under defeat and pulls the traveler back; this does not promise literal immortality.
loop_rules.retry: The Spire rearranges its passageways. A fresh expedition is needed; permanent progress remains per actual game rules.
loop_rules.simple_branching: Use only previous completed/failed run outcome, not floor-specific generated dialogues. Failed-run return is two short beats; next run one lightly changed greeting.
loop_rules.replay_policy: Do not replay act1 explanation every run. First run gets act1; later runs get retry or return. Act2/3 can use existing story-skip setting.
